results.name: Persona Coverage
results.reasoning: Cloud Infrastructure Admin has stories but Cloud Infrastructure Admin is not a standard OSAC persona — the gold standard has no Cloud Infrastructure Admin section and instead uses Cloud Provider Admin plus Tenant Admin/User; more critically, the generated doc has no explicit 'Not affected' note for any persona and merges Tenant Admin and Tenant User into separate sections while the gold standard combines them, but the real gap is that the generated doc includes a non-standard persona (Cloud Infrastructure Admin) instead of properly covering all four OSAC personas.

results.name: Persona-Story Alignment
results.reasoning: Most attributions are correct, but the generated doc assigns 'automated storage deployment on tenant clusters' to Cloud Infrastructure Admin rather than Cloud Provider Admin (as in gold standard), and lacks sanitization stories entirely, so no misattribution there, but the deployment automation story is misplaced.

results.name: In Scope / Out of Scope Accuracy
results.reasoning: The generated document misclassifies several items and omits key out-of-scope items: volume resize and volume snapshots/clones are missing from Out of Scope; the generated doc incorrectly keeps 'Vendor REST adapters' in Out of Scope linked to OSAC-984 which is correct but combines UI integration incorrectly; more critically, In Scope items diverge significantly — the generated doc mentions multiple vendors (NetApp, VAST, Pure Storage) when gold standard specifies VAST-only for v0.2, and adds 'attachment information' and 'status visibility' items not structured as in gold, while missing key in-scope items like Private Volume API and Storage driver packaging.
